messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SYNTH CANARY FAILURE detected for `canary-prober-eu1` across multiple regions. 12/15 probes failing (timeouts). PD: PagerDuty incident PD-9876 created.

Aisha: Acked. Investigating. @pagerduty please mute noisy repeats for 15m.

pagerduty: Incident PD-9876 assigned to Aisha. Auto-ack by Aisha at 2026-03-15T12:35:10Z

Priya: Looking at prober-runner logs, getting repeated `504 read_timeout` to /v1/health. Not seeing high CPU on prober pods yet.

Marco: Any recent deploys? Could be cert rotation thrashing TLS handshakes.

Jae: We rotated certs for the internal loadbalancer around 12:20. Rolling back certs on lb is risky; let's check connection handshake errors first.

Priya: Logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T12:34:56Z] prober-runner-3: POST /probe -> 504 read_timeout (upstream: 10.0.32.18:443)
[2026-03-15T12:34:58Z] prober-runner-5: TLS handshake error: remote error: handshake failure
```

Aisha: I'm going to scale prober-runner to reduce queueing and flip canary to fallback pool. Command:
```
kubectl -n synth scale deployment prober-runner --replicas=6
# flip routing: set annotation synth/prober-pool=stable
```

incident-bot: Action executed: scaled prober-runner -> 6 replicas.

Priya: Scaled. Prober pods are coming up. Initial probe success rate rising to ~40%.

Aisha: I've muted the PD noise for 20m and set alert to require 3 consecutive failures. Notifying customers? Any direct user-facing errors reported?

Jae: No customer-facing errors in observability, only synthetic failures. No impact on request success rates or latencies for real traffic.

Marco: Good — this looks like internal noise from cert rotation + a small prober capacity dip. Keep PD suppressed for now. Create a short incident note with root cause hypothesis and mitigation.

Aisha: Will do. Drafting note:
- Root cause: internal LB cert rotation temporarily caused TLS handshake failures for prober runners -> timed out probes.
- Mitigation: scaled prober-runner; adjusted probe backoff and alert threshold; add preflight cert check to deploy pipeline.

Priya: Follow-up tasks: #1 add TLS preflight in deploy CI, #2 make probe backoff exponential with jitter, #3 add runbook step to coordinate cert rotations with prober schedule.

pagerduty: Incident PD-9876 status: acknowledged -> resolved (no customer impact) at 2026-03-15T12:50:03Z

Aisha: Handoff: @Priya taking post-incident action items. I'll update the incident ticket and close this thread in 30m unless more regressions.

Priya: Copy. I'll open GH issues and link to PD-9876.

incident-bot: Closing alert group for canary-prober-eu1. :white_check_mark:

Aisha: TL;DR: noisy canary alerts caused by LB cert rotation, mitigated with a short scale-up and policy tweaks; no customer impact. :thumbsup:
